text:
oliver: deploy-bot flagged a sustained embeddings p95 regression on a dedicated pool (ap-northeast1). trigger_count=5, auto-revert_threshold=3. looks customer-facing.

deploy-bot: ALERT: dedicated/ap-northeast1 | route=embeddings | p95_latency=610ms (+42%) | trigger_count=5 | auto_revert_threshold=3 | action=AUTO_REVERT_RECOMMEND

sam: i'm oncall. which customers affected? can we avoid an auto-revert without notifying account?

acct-bot: AFFECTED: acct=StudySpace (dedicated-ap-northeast1), acct=BrightLeaf (test-slice).

ops-bot: POLICY: Auto-revert will fire after threshold unless `deploybot.hold=true` set by a human. Hold suppression will last until unset or window closes.

claire: given dedicated customer StudySpace, prefer manual partial pin to previous variant to avoid a full revert and customer surprise. propose: set hold and pin embeddings to v3.8-stable for that pool only.

oliver: agree. i'll set hold now. `deploybot.hold=true` -> done. deploy-bot: acknowledge hold by oliver at 4472000015.

oliver: running `infractl route update --pool=ap-northeast1 --route=embeddings --variant=v3.8-stable --split=100% --note="dedicated-stability-pin"` at 4472000020

deploy-bot: LOG: route update accepted. healthcheck: 3/3 passing. p95 decreased to 170ms.

sam: good. claire please ping accounts + sales with a short message and ask if they want a call.

claire: msg posted to sales: "StudySpace - we've routed embeddings traffic to previous stable variant in ap-northeast1 after observed latency spike. No data exposure. Monitoring; we'll share RCA within 24h."

acct-bot: Sales notified: PING sent to owner.

oliver: created incident INC-2026-599, attached logs and infractl CLI history. assigned to eng-runtime for RCA, ETA 24h.

ops-bot: RUNBOOK: Partial pin executed by oliver at 4472000020. Monitor 30m. If p95 regresses to >baseline+25% for 3 consecutive min, escalate to oncall.

sam: adding deployment metadata: `rollback.partial=embeddings`, `rollback.scope=dedicated-ap-northeast1`, `operator=oliver`, `start=4472000020`.

claire: drafted release-notes blurb and put in #release-notes-drafts: "Temporarily pinned embeddings variant for ap-northeast1 dedicated pool due to latency regression. Investigating; will follow up with RCA."

ops-bot: REMINDER: unset `deploybot.hold` only after eng-runtime signoff or planned canary re-run. Unset will re-enable auto policies.

oliver: leaving hold in place. closing thread but will reopen if alert returns. thanks all.
